daily_summary: 当日两个 commit 都是 P/D 分离场景下的正确性/可用性修复。第一个修复 Mooncake KV 传输（Hybrid 连接器以及 V1/V2 P 侧 scheduler）在 prefill 生产者丢弃最后一个 prompt token 后未清理过期 block hash 的问题：改为优先调用 vLLM 0.34+ 的 Request.truncate_block_hashes(hash_block_size, lookahead) 增量截断，并为旧版本提供共享 fallback（只裁剪非法后缀并清空 prompt-embedding hash 缓存），从而既消除陈旧前缀命中，又避免重新全量 hash 长 prompt 的 CPU 开销；同时把原先分散在三个 scheduler 里的重复逻辑收敛到 kv_transfer/utils。第二个修复 API server 启动阶段文件日志不遵守 --additional-config 中 ascend_log_path 的问题：configure_ascend_file_logging 改为显式接收目录参数，去掉隐式的全局 AscendConfig 查询，platform 在 config 校验前用 additional_config 传入，worker 用 init_ascend_config() 返回值传入。整体方向是把隐式全局状态换成显式参数传递，并统一 KV 传输侧的 hash 生命周期管理。
test_impact_summary: 两个 commit 都在同一 PR 内完成了测试同步，测试策略上是“替换而非新增笼统用例”：KV 传输侧删除了独立的 test_prefill_hash_truncation.py（195 行全量重建对比用例），把核心断言收敛到 test_pull_scheduler.py 的 no-rehash/embedding 缓存清空用例、test_base_scheduler/test_mooncake_connector 的 truncate_block_hashes 调用断言，以及 test_hybrid_prefix_truncation 的 admission 时 hash 对齐断言，覆盖了 lookup 表项与原 block_hasher 的 hash 几何一致性问题（block hasher 现在带 lookahead 参数）。日志侧新增 test_platform_startup_log_directory 覆盖“API server 早期日志写入自定义/默认目录”，worker 构造函数测试新增对 configure_ascend_file_logging 实参的断言。需要持续看护的薄弱点是：1) Mooncake Hybrid 连接器与 V1 连接器路径目前只有 mock 级别的 truncate 调用断言，缺少真实 hash 等价性回归；2) fallback 分支（旧 vLLM 无原生 API）只在部分用例中通过 monkeypatch 覆盖，prompt_embeds 缓存清理只用单一场景验证；3) configure_ascend_file_logging 签名改为必填参数，属于破坏性接口变更，需要保证仓库内（含 _310p、patch、测试）所有调用点都已更新，建议加一条静态/调用点检查或 UT 防止回归。

commits.comment: 修复 Mooncake KV 传输 P 侧 prefill 截断后 block hash 陈旧的问题，属于 #21166 Hybrid 连接器部分的收尾。核心改动有三点：(1) mooncake/base_scheduler.py 的 _truncate_request_for_prefill 不再无条件 block_hashes.clear()+update_block_hashes()，而是先用 getattr 探测 request.truncate_block_hashes 是否可调用，可调用时传 (kv_cache_config.hash_block_size, vllm_config.num_hash_lookahead_tokens) 做增量截断，否则走新增的 truncate_block_hashes_fallback；(2) mooncake_hybrid_connector.py 的同类方法此前完全没有处理 block_hashes（正是 stale hash 的来源），现在补上了同样的原生/回退两条路径，与 V1/V2 行为对齐；(3) 新增 vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/utils/utils.py::truncate_block_hashes_fallback，用 max(0, request.num_tokens - lookahead) // hash_block_size 计算有效 hash 数并 del block_hashes[num_valid_hashes:]，同时 clear _prompt_embeds_per_block_hashes，对 vLLM < 0.34 保证不重算前缀也能丢弃失效后缀。实现方向正确：把 hash 截断交给 vLLM 的 hash 策略，避免在 Ascend 侧重新实现 hash 语义；从微基准看 131k token 场景从 3.39ms 降到 7.6µs，收益明显。潜在风险：a) 两个新引入的 assert hash_block_size is not None，若某些调用路径（例如旧版 vLLM 或构造期未注入 kv_cache_config）缺少该字段会直接抛 AssertionError 而不是降级；b) fallback 依赖 request.num_tokens 在 num_prompt_tokens 递减后等于截断后的 prompt 长度，这一隐含契约依赖上游 Request 语义，若后续 num_tokens 计入 output token 会算错；c) fallback 只裁后缀不重建，若上游 block_hashes 本身不完整（长度短于应有值）只能保持不完整，语义上可接受但需要文档说明；d) 三个 scheduler（V1/Hybrid/V2 base）各自复制了同样的探测逻辑，仍有进一步抽公共 helper 的空间。整体为 bugfix + performance，风险中等但被同 PR 的大量回归覆盖。

commits.message:
[BugFix][KV Transfer] Trim stale Mooncake prefill hashes without rehashing the prefix (#21437)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Addresses the Hybrid connector portion of #21166. When the prefill
producer drops the last prompt token, any block hash covering that token
becomes stale. The Hybrid connector could retain that hash. Mooncake V1
rebuilt the entire prefix. After #22167, V2 still did so on vLLM
versions earlier than 0.34 when the native truncation method was
unavailable.

These three scheduler paths now trim hashes before the local prefix
lookup using the engine-resolved hash block size and the configured hash
lookahead. V2 Pull and Push inherit the same change. Each scheduler
calls `Request.truncate_block_hashes()` when the method is callable. For
vLLM versions earlier than 0.34 that lack it, a shared fallback trims
the invalid suffix in place and clears the prompt-embedding hash cache.
The existing one-token and rescheduling guards still apply.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Hybrid uses the shortened prompt for prefix reuse, and long text
prompts avoid the full-prefix hash pass during producer admission.

### How was this patch tested?

- Added a V2 connector regression using the vLLM request and block
hasher. It compares the result with an independently hashed shortened
request and checks that reentry makes zero hasher calls. Two cases cover
the hash boundary: an embedding prompt loses one hash when a lookahead
token is removed, and a text prompt keeps all complete hashes when a
partial tail is removed. The Hybrid scheduler test checks hash alignment
at admission.
- On the earlier revision, executed an isolated CPU source-level check
against both vLLM `c410543d` and `v0.33.0`. It ran the three affected
scheduler truncation methods and the respective upstream hash functions
on request fixtures. All 84 cases per version passed.
- Earlier-revision CPU microbenchmark of the V2 scheduler truncation
method on Windows, Python 3.12, vLLM `c410543d`, 131,072 text tokens,
hash block size 128, zero lookahead. The median of 31 calls was 3.39 ms
on Ascend main and 7.6 µs with this patch. Prompt construction and
initial hashing were outside the timed region. This measures the
host-side truncation operation only.
- After merging main at b75753a20f, the six affected CPU/mock test files
passed on vLLM 4ba787ec with the prepared Python 3.12 environment (403
passed, 14 skipped). The default workspace environment stopped during
conftest imports (Step5 with the workspace vLLM checkout, or
Kimi_K25VisionConfig with the compatible checkout).
- A separate CPU source-level replay on vLLM c410543d exercised the
three updated truncation methods with real Requests and real block
hashes. All 120 cases passed across native delegation and an unavailable
method, including lookahead, token IDs, prompt embeddings, reentry and
zero rehash calls.
- Ruff check, Ruff format and git diff --check passed. The new commit
has CPU validation. Earlier NPU results were obtained on the previous
revision.

The six-file test command was run from the merged Ascend worktree with
PYTHONPATH pointing to that worktree and the compatible vLLM checkout,
and UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT pointing to the prepared CPU venv.

~~~sh
uv run --no-sync pytest -q --import-mode=importlib \

tests/ut/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/mooncake/test_scheduler_integration.py
\
  tests/ut/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/test_mooncake_connector.py \
  tests/ut/kv_offload/mooncake_v2/test_base_scheduler.py \
  tests/ut/kv_offload/mooncake_v2/test_pull_scheduler.py \
  tests/ut/kv_offload/mooncake_v2/test_swa_handoff.py \
  tests/ut/kv_offload/test_hybrid_prefix_truncation.py
~~~

### Checklist

- [x] Boundary and edge-case coverage
- [x] Regression test
- [x] Meaningful and reliable tests
- [x] Performance impact checked with a microbenchmark and a zero-rehash
assertion

## 设计原则 Review

The scheduler reuses vLLM's hash policy and existing KV configuration.
The native API check stays at each call site. The KV transfer utilities
provide the fallback for vLLM versions earlier than 0.34. The regression
checks both hash identity and the absence of prefix rehashing. The
change adds no configuration or remote operations.

Prepared with AI assistance.

commits.comment: 修复 API server 启动阶段文件日志不遵守 --additional-config 中 ascend_log_path 的问题。根因是 configure_ascend_file_logging() 在 NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config 中被最先调用，此时进程级 AscendConfig 尚未初始化（init_ascend_config 发生在 worker 里），函数内部的 get_ascend_config() 抛异常被 except 吞掉，于是回落到默认 _LOG_DIR。修复方式是把隐式全局查询改为显式目录参数：logger.configure_ascend_file_logging(log_dir: str | None)，None 表示默认目录；platform.py 从 vllm_config.additional_config.get('ascend_log_path') 取值（在 config 校验会输出启动日志之前），worker.py 则使用 init_ascend_config(vllm_config) 的返回值 ascend_config.ascend_log_path。这一改动符合项目“减少隐式全局状态”的方向，也让前端进程与 workers 写同一目录，避免了此前 API server 日志落在默认目录而 EngineCore/worker 落在自定义目录的割裂。风险点：a) 函数签名由无参变为必填位置参数，属于内部 API 的破坏性变更，任何遗漏的调用点（_310p 路径、patch 模块、外部脚本、其他 PR 并行改动）都会 TypeError，建议在仓库内做一次全量 caller 检索或加一条守护测试；b) 平台侧只读取 additional_config 原始 dict，若 ascend_log_path 类型非法（非字符串）目前只在 _setup_file_logging/_rotate 阶段暴露，缺少早期校验；c) 多个进程并发在同一目录使用轮转文件 handler，仍有按 size/时间轮转时的文件竞争与命名一致性问题（此前 worker 全部写默认目录时同样存在，本次改动扩大了可见范围）；d) 保留了 `if log_dir and log_dir != _LOG_DIR` 的分支，空串会被当作默认目录，语义需在 docstring 中明确（当前 docstring 只说明 None）。整体为低风险 bugfix，测试覆盖到位。

test_impact.reason: 签名变更使原有测试中的无参 monkeypatch（如 tests/ut/patch/worker/test_patch_dspark_eplb.py 的 lambda: None）失效，必须改为 lambda log_dir: None；同时新增了行为断言：tests/ut/test_platform.py::test_platform_startup_log_directory 参数化 use_custom_path，在 _ASCEND_CONFIG 置 None、清空 logger handlers 的前提下调用 check_and_update_config，断言日志文件落在期望目录、内容包含启动 warning，且自定义路径时默认目录不存在（直接验证“配置未初始化也能生效”这一 bug 场景）；tests/ut/worker/test_worker_inheritance.py 让 init_ascend_config 返回带 ascend_log_path 的 SimpleNamespace，并断言 file_logging.assert_called_once_with(setup.ascend_config.ascend_log_path)，把 worker 侧的实参传递也纳入看护。

[BugFix] Honor ascend_log_path from API server startup (#22482)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

API server file logs were written to the default directory even when
`ascend_log_path` was set in `--additional-config`, because file logging
was configured before the process-wide Ascend configuration existed.

The existing `configure_ascend_file_logging(log_dir)` function now takes
the directory explicitly. The platform passes the launch option before
config validation emits startup logs; `None` selects the default
directory. The worker passes `ascend_log_path` from the configuration
returned by `init_ascend_config()`. There is no separate
`setup_ascend_file_logging` entrypoint or implicit global-config lookup
in file logging.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. API server file logs honor `--additional-config
'{"ascend_log_path": "/path/to/logs"}'` from startup. Omitting the
option continues to use the default directory. The release note uses the
wording requested by the reviewer in
`release_notes/fragments/22482.yaml`.

### How was this patch tested?

#### Local CPU/mock validation of the explicit-directory implementation
(2026-11-20)

Used the repository's checked-in `vllm-ascend/.venv`, with isolated
`PYTHONPATH` overlays for vLLM
`4ba787ec9959e566d3b587a796dff07673324da5` and Transformers 5.19.0. The
shared virtual environment was not modified.

| Command, run from the vllm-ascend worktree | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `uv run pytest -q tests/ut/test_logger.py
tests/ut/test_platform.py::test_platform_startup_log_directory
tests/ut/worker/test_worker_inheritance.py` | 47 passed |
| `uv run pytest -q tests/ut/test_platform.py` | 191 passed, 1 skipped;
113 subtests passed |
| `uv run pytest -q
tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_balance_schedule.py
tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_eplb.py
tests/ut/patch/worker/test_patch_dspark_eplb.py` | 86 passed, 1 skipped,
4 setup errors |
| `uv run --no-sync bash format.sh ci` | All hooks passed |
| `git diff --check` | Passed |

The same patch-test command on the unchanged previous PR head
`9169593c82` also had 86 passed, 1 skipped and the same four DSpark
setup errors. All four errors occur in upstream `ParallelConfig`
validation rejecting EPLB on the CPU platform, before the logging call
under test.

The startup regression checks actual file records for custom and omitted
paths before Ascend config initialization. The worker constructor tests
now assert that file logging receives the path returned by config
initialization. Six isolated file-logging checks also passed, covering
custom/default paths, explicit worker paths, independence from global
Ascend config, and invalid directories.

Without the isolated dependency overlays, the regular local pytest
command stopped during collection because the installed vLLM lacked
`vllm.models.step5.common`; using the matching vLLM source then exposed
the older installed Transformers version. The isolated overlays resolve
those collection issues.

#### Earlier A3 service validation of the startup-path fix

Before the function simplification, revision `0b403fac38` was compared
against parent `3385405116` in a dedicated container on Ascend A3 using
Qwen3-8B, BF16, TP2 and eager serving. The image was pinned to
`quay.nju.edu.cn/ascend/vllm-ascend@sha256:1d907ff82ce459e810d383fa9a0d4396d0e29d3947ba979ab66639e0cf8e2cf2`,
with vLLM `4ba787ec99`.

The parent API server opened its file log in the default directory. With
the fix, the API server, EngineCore and both TP workers used the
configured directory, with no default-directory file for the fixed API
server PID. Two requests producing 10 greedy tokens each returned
identical text and token counts between the parent and fixed revisions.

The explicit-directory simplification has CPU/mock coverage above but
has not been rerun on NPU: the retained .2 container and host SSH
endpoints were unreachable during this update. Hardware/CI revalidation
remains pending.

### Design

Reuses the existing launch option and rotating file handler. Both
frontend and worker callers pass the directory explicitly; full Ascend
config initialization stays after its existing validation and
normalization steps.
